answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The summit cap is policed at intake and mirror makes public the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a shale tag. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
